data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after an enemy unit finishes shooting.

**Target:** An **ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT** unit of yours that was a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** A unit [embarked](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in the **TRANSPORT** can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) under the rules of [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), then shoot under the rules of [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). Its only possible target is that enemy unit, and only if that unit is a valid target for it.
